spec.basis: Andrew Fisher, 31 Oct 2026 (this chat, ~01:xx AEST): who did the Armorzone TL2 water barriers on contract 9972648 (STPS, Brisbane Traffic) and their hours, day by day, install and demob, so the hours sit against the people who did them and the contract they are charged on. Each note goes on the person's labour row for the day through the page's own setOurCost (a row the tracker or the record already holds) or addOurCost (a person with no row that day). Hours on an existing row are not changed; a new row carries the hours Andrew gave. Start and finish times are not known for the nights and are not invented. The S08 run's demob is this coming Tuesday and is recorded then.
